Class IpfSpanDecorator

java.lang.Object
org.apache.camel.telemetry.decorators.AbstractSpanDecorator
org.openehealth.ipf.platform.camel.ihe.core.IpfSpanDecorator
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.camel.telemetry.SpanDecorator
Direct Known Subclasses:
FhirSpanDecorator, Hl7v2SpanDecorator, WsSpanDecorator
public abstract class IpfSpanDecorator extends org.apache.camel.telemetry.decorators.AbstractSpanDecorator
Base class for the span decorators of IPF's eHealth transaction components.

Adds the metadata of the eHealth transaction the endpoint stands for to the span created by camel-telemetry, on top of the endpoint tags that AbstractSpanDecorator already contributes. The metadata is obtained generically through InteractionAwareComponent, so this class needs no knowledge of the individual transaction families.

Trace context propagation is deliberately not implemented here. For SOAP and HTTP based transactions it is performed by the underlying libraries (CXF and the HTTP clients respectively); their instrumentation establishes the context before the exchange reaches the Camel route, and the span created for the route joins it. Overriding AbstractSpanDecorator.getExtractor(Exchange) or AbstractSpanDecorator.getInjector(Exchange) would compete with that. HL7v2 over MLLP, which has no such mechanism, is the exception and is handled by its own decorator.

A concrete subclass exists per endpoint scheme and does nothing but name it, because camel-telemetry registers decorators in a map keyed on SpanDecorator.getComponent(): 

public class XdsIti18SpanDecorator extends WsSpanDecorator {
    @Override
    public String getComponent() {
        return "xds-iti18";
    }
}
